svg.title: SY70202K application schematic
svg.desc: Application schematic of the SY70202K PMIC (four buck converters and two LDOs), redrawn from the datasheet. The 2.8 to 3.7 V input VIN feeds the VIN_B1 to VIN_B4 and VIN_LDO1 pins, each with its own capacitor (10 µF for the bucks, 1 µF for the LDO) to the PGND pin beside it, and the AVIN pin through a series resistor R0 with a 1 µF capacitor C0 to ground. Each buck switch pin SW_B1 to SW_B4 goes through a 0.47 µH inductor to the output, which also returns to the matching FB_B pin; each output has two 22 µF capacitors. LDO1 and LDO2 have 1 µF output capacitors. GPIO1 and GPIO3 to GPIO8 are pulled up to VIN through 100 kΩ resistors, SCL and SDA through 4.7 kΩ resistors, and AGND is grounded.
svg.text: R4 to R9: 100 kΩ pull-ups to VIN
